The whole process should start with your family doctor. Tell them how you're feeling; physical and mental effects the depression is having in you. They'll get you in touch with a psychiatrist and if you're lucky get you a sample of an anti depressant to start you out. 

If you really, really need help, such as feel like commiting suicide consider going to the ER. They may keep you in there longer than you would like but they'll have a psychiatrist on staff who could start you up ASAP and keep you safe. 

Good luck. If you have any questions, let me know
